G5297.d: ὑπο-φέρω ; [in LXX for נָשָׂא, etc. ;] ; to bear by being under. Metaphorical, to endure: with accusative of thing(s), 1Co.10:13, 2Ti.3:11, 1Pe.2:19.†; (AS)

G5235.d: ὑπερ-βάλλω ; [in LXX: Job.15:11 A (†), Sir.5:7 25:11, al. ;] ; __1. trans., to throw over or beyond. ; __2. Intrans., to run beyond. In both senses, metaphorically, to exceed, surpass, transcend: 2Co.3:10 9:14, Eph.1:19 2:7; with genitive obj., Eph.3:19.†; (AS)

G5287.d: ὑπό-στασις, -εως, ἡ; (ὑφίστημι, to set under, stand under, support) [in LXX for מַצָּב (1Ki.13:23 14:4 B), תִּקְוָה (Rut.1:12, Eze.19:5), etc., also in Wis.16:21 ;] ; __1. a support, base or foundation (in various senses). ; __2. substance (Arist., al.; opposite to φαντασία, ἔμφασις): Heb.1:3 ; __3. steadiness, firmness (Polyb., al.), hence, assurance, confidence: 2Co.9:4 11:17, Heb.3:14 11:1 (here perhaps title-deed, as that which gives reality or guarantee; see MM, xxv).†; (AS)

G5292.d: ὑπο-ταγή, -ῆς, ἡ ; [in LXX: Wis.18:16 A * ;] ; subjection: 2Co.9:13, Gal.2:5. 1Ti.2:11 3:4.†; (AS)

G5239.d: ὑπερ-εκ-τείνω ; to stretch out overmuch: metaphorically, ἑαυτούς, 2Co.10:14.† ; (AS)

G5238.d: ὑπερ-έκεινα ; comp. adv. (see Bl., 28, 2; M, Pr., 99), ; beyond: as prep. with genitive, τὰ ὑ. ὑμῶν, 2Co.10:16 (Byz. and Ecc.1:1-18.).†; (AS)

G5234.d: ὑπερβαλλόντως ; [in LXX: Job.15:11 א B (†) * ;] ; above measure: 2Co.11:23.†; (AS)

G5229.d: ὑπερ-αίρω ; [in LXX: 2Ch.32:23 (נָשָׂא ni.), etc. ;] ; to lift or raise over. Mid., to uplift oneself: 2Co.12:7; before ἐπί, with accusative, of person(s), 2Th.2:4 (cf. 2Ma.5:23).†; (AS)

G5272.d: ὑπό-κρισις, -εως, ἡ; (ὑποκρίνομαι, which see) [in LXX: 2Ma.6:25 * ;] ; __1. a reply, answer (Hdt.). ; __2. play-acting (Arist., Polyb., al.). Metaphorical, pretence, hypocrisy: Mat.23:28, Mrk.12:15, Luk.12:1, Gal.2:13, 1Ti.4:2, 1Pe.2:1 (Polyb., Pss Sng.4:7).†; (AS)

G5231.d: ὑπερ-άνω ; compound adv., [in LXX for עַל, מֵעָל, etc. ;] ; above: as prep. with genitive, Eph.1:21 4:10, Heb.9:5.†; (AS)

G5215.d: ὕμνος, -ου, ὁ ; [in LXX for תְּהִלָּה, נְגִינָה, שִׁיר, etc. ;] ; a hymn; ; __(a) in cl. a festal song in praise of gods or heroes; ; __(b) in LXX and NT a song of praise addressed to God: Eph.5:19, Col.3:16.†; SYN.: ψαλμός, that which is sung to a musical accompaniment; ᾠδή, the generic term for song (cf. Tr., Syn., § LXXviii, Lft. on Col.3:16) (AS)

G5251.d: ὑπερ-υψόω, -ῶ ; [in LXX: Psa.37:35 (עָרִיץ) Psa.97:9 (עָלָה ni.), Da TH Dan.4:34 11:12 (רוּם), ib. LXX TH Dan.3:52 ff.* ;] ; __1. to exalt beyond measure, exalt to the highest place: Php.2:9. ; __2. to extol (Da, ll. with).†; (AS)

G5227.d: ὑπ-εναντίος, -α, -ον ; [in LXX for אָיַב, צַר, etc. ;] ; set over against, opposite. Metaphorical (Plat., Arist., al.), opposed to, contrary to: with dative of person(s), Col.2:14; absol., as subst., ὁ ὑ., Heb.10:27 (cf. Isa.26:11).†; (AS)

G5233.d: ὑπερ-βαίνω ; [in LXX for עָבַר, etc. ;] ; __1. trans., to step over, trans­gress (R, overreach: 1Th.4:6). ; __2. Intrans., to transgress: metaphorically, 1Th.4:6 (R, txt.; see M, Th., in l).†; (AS)

G5232.d: ὑπερ-αυξάνω ; to increase beyond measure: 2Th.1:3 (see Lft., Notes, 98).†; (AS)

G5250.d: ὑπερ-πλεονάζω ; to abound exceedingly: 1Ti.1:14 (Ps Sol 5:19; Herm., Mand., v, 2, 5).†; (AS)

G5296.d: ὑπο-τύπωσις, -εως, ἡ; (ὑποτυπόω, to delineate), ; an outline, sketch. Metaphorical, a pattern, example: 1Ti.1:16, 2Ti.1:13.†; SYN.: ὁμοίωμα, τύπος, ὑπόδειγμα (see DB, iii, 696b) (AS)

G5202.d: ὑδροποτίω, -ῶ; (ὕδωρ, πίνω), [in LXX: Dan LXX 1:12 שָׁתָה מַיִם) * ;] ; to drink water, opposite to οἴνῳ χρῆσθαι: 1Ti.5:23 (Hdt., i, 71; Plat., Rep., 561 with, al.).†; (AS)

G5283.d: ὑπόνοια, -ας, ἡ; (ὑπονοέω), [in LXX: Dan LXX 4:16, 32 5:6 (רַעְיוֹן), Sir 3:34* ;] ; a suspicion: 1Ti.6:4.†; (AS)

G5280.d: ὑπόμινησις, -εως, ἡ; (ὑπομιμνήσκω) [in LXX: Psa.71:6 א (תְּהִלָּה), Wis.16:11, 2Ma.6:17 * ;] ; a reminding, reminder: ἐν ὑ., 2Pe.1:13 3:1; with genitive, 2Ti.1:5.†; (AS)

G5279.d: ὑπο-μιμνήσκω ; [in LXX: 3Ki.4:3 B ( hi.), Wis.12:1 18:22, 4Ma.18:14 * ;] ; to cause one to remember, put one in mind or remind one of: with accusative of thing(s), 2Ti.2:14, 3Jn.10; with dupl. accusative (Thus., al.), Jhn.14:26; with accusative of person(s), before περί, 2Pe.1:12; id., before ὅτι, Ju 5; with inf., Tit.3:1; pass., with genitive of thing(s), Luk.22:61.†; (AS)

G5270.d: ύπο-κάτω comp. adv. (see M, Pr., 99), ; [in LXX chiefly for תַּחַת ;] ; below, under: as prep. with genitive, Mat.22:44, Mrk.6:11 7:28 12:36 (Rec., R, txt., ὑποπόδιον, as in LXX), Luk.8:16, Jhn.1:51, Heb.2:8" (LXX), Rev.5:3, 13 6:9 12:1.†; (AS)

G5262.d: ὑπό-δειγμα, -τος, τό; (ὑποδείκνυμι), [in LXX: Eze.42:15, Sir.44:16, 2Ma.6:28 2Mac 6:31, 4Ma.17:23 * ;] ; used by later writers (Xen. onwards) for παράδειγμα (see Rutherford, NPhr., 62), ; __(a) a figure, copy: Heb.8:5 9:23; ; __(b) an example: for imitation, Jhn.13:15, Jas.5:10; for warning, Heb.4:11, 2Pe.2:6.†; SYN.: ὁμοίωμα, τύπος, ὑποτύπωσις (see DB, iii. 696b) (AS)

G5289.d: ὑπο-στολή, -ῆς, ἡ; (ὑποστέλλω), ; __1. a letting down, lowering (Plut.). ; __2. a shrinking back (Hesych.): οὐκ ἐσμὲν ὑποστολῆς (on the genitive, see Bl., § 35, 2), Heb.10:39.†; (AS)

G5226.d: ὑπ-είκω ; [in LXX: 4Ma.6:35 * ;] ; __1. to retire, withdraw. ; __2. to yield, submit: metaphorically, Heb.13:17.†; (AS)

G5217.d: ὑπ-άγω ; [in LXX: Exo.14:21 (הָלַךְ hi.), elsewhere only as seel., Tob.8:21, al. ;] ; a word of the vulgar language, in Pres. and imperfect only (Bl., § 53, 1). ; __I. Trans. ; __1. to lead or bring under, subdue (Hom., Hdt., al.; Ex, l.with). ; __2. to lead on slowly (Hdt., Xen., al.). ; __II. Intrans., to go slowly away, withdraw oneself, depart (so less frequently in cl.; Thuc., Eur., al.): absol., Mat.8:32 13:44, Mrk.6:33, Luk.8:42 17:14, Jhn.6:67 8:2 11:44 14:5, 28 18:8; οἱ ἐρχόμενοι κ. οἱ ὑπάγοντες, Mrk.6:31; ὑπῆγον κ. ἐπίστευον, Jhn.12:11; ἵνα ὑπαγῆτε κ. καρπὸν ψέρητε, Jhn.15:16; opposite to ἔρχεσθαι, Jhn.3:8 8:14; imperat., ὕπαγε, Mat.4:10 8:13 20:14, Mrk.2:9 T, Mrk.7:29 10:52; εἰς ε…

G5208.d: ὕλη, -ης, ἡ ; [in LXX: Job.19:29 (†) Job.38:40 (סֻכָּה), Psa.69:2 B.l א (יָוֵן), Isa.10:17 (שָׁמִיר), Wis.11:17 15:13, Sir.28:10, 2Ma.2:24, 4Ma.1:29 * ;] ; __1. wood, forest, woodland (Thus., Xen., al.). ; __2. wood, timber, fuel (Hom., Hdt., Thuc., al.): Jas.3:5 (see Hort, Ja., 70, 104 f.). ; __3. = Lat. materia, esp. in Philosophy, matter (Arist. and later writers; Wis, ll. with).†; (AS)

G5277.d: ὑπο-λιμτάνω ; collat. form of ὑπολείπω, ; to leave behind: 1Pe.2:21.†; (AS)

G5261.d: ὑπογραμμός, -οῦ, ὁ; (ὑπογράφω, (a) to write under; (b) to trace letters for copying), [in LXX: 2Ma.2:28 * ;] ; __1. a writing-copy, hence, ; __2. an example: 1Pe.2:11 (Philo).†; (AS)

G5268.d: ὑπο-ζύγιος, -α, -ον ; [in LXX for חֲמוֹר ;] ; under the yoke; as subst., τ . (Hdt., al.), a beast of burden; colloq., an ass (see Deiss., BS, 160 f.), and so always in LXX and NT: Mat.21:5 (LXX), 2Pe.2:16.†; (AS)

G5246.d: ὑπέρ-ογκος, -ον ; [in LXX: Deu.30:11 (פָּלָא), etc. ;] ; of excessive weight or size; metaphorically, excessive, immoderate, in late writers, of arrogant speech (see Mayor on Ju, l.with): n. pl., 2Pe.2:18, Ju 16.†; (AS)

G5254.d: ὑπ-έχω ; [in LXX: Psa.89:50 (נָשָׂא), La 5:7 (סָבַל), Wis.12:21, 2Ma.4:48 * ;] ; to hold or put under. Metaphorical, to undergo, suffer: δίκην, Ju 7 (Soph., Eur., al.).†; (AS)

G5273.d: ὑπο-κριτής, -οῦ, ὁ; (ὑποκρίνομαι, which see) [in LXX Job.34:30 36:13 (חָנֵף) * ;] ; __1. one who answers, an interpreter (Plat.). ; __2. a stage player, actor (Plut., Xen., al.). Metaphorical (in LXX and NT), a pretender, dissembler, hypocrite: Mat.6:2, 5 6:16 7:5 15:7 22:18 23:13-15 24:51, Mrk.7:6 Luk.6:42 12:56 13:15.†; (AS)

G5221.d: ὑπ-αντάω, -ῶ ; [in LXX: Dan LXX 10:14 (קָרָה), Sir.9:3, al. ;] ; to go to meet, meet: with dative of person(s) (see M, Pr., 64), Mat.8:28 28:9, Mrk.5:2, Luk.8:27 17:12 (ἀπ-, WH, txt.), Jhn.4:51 11:20, 30 12:18, Act.16:16; of meeting in battle, Luk.14:31.†; (AS)

G5243.d: ὑπερηφανία, -ας, ἡ; (ὑπερήφανος, which see), [in LXX chiefly for גָּאוֹן and cogn. forms ;] ; haughtiness, arrogance, disdain: Mrk.7:22 (Plat., Xen.).†; (AS)

G5276.d: ὑπολήνιον, -ου, τό; (ὑπό, ληνός), [in LXX: Jol.3:13 (4:13), Hag.2:17, (16), Zec.14:10, Isa.16:10 (יֶקֶב) * ;] ; a vessel or trough beneath a winepress to receive the juice (RV, a pit for the winepress): Mrk.12:1 (see Swete, in l, and cf. ληνός).†; (AS)

G5298.d: ὑπο-χωρέω ; [in LXX: Jdg.20:37 B (-), Sir.13:9, 2Ma.12:12 * ;] ; to go back, retire: before ἐν, Luk.5:16; before εἰς, Luk.9:10.†; (AS)

G5240.d: ὑπερ-εκ-χύννω (Rec. -ύνω), late form of -χέω ; to pour out over. Pass., to overflow, run over: Luk.6:38 (not elsewhere).†; (AS)

G5203.d: ὑδρωπικός, -ή, -όν; (ὕδρωψ, dropsy), ; dropsical, suffering from dropsy: Luk.14:2.†; (AS)

G5291.d: ὑπο-στρωννύω ; [in LXX: Isa.58:5 (יָצָא hi.), etc. ;] ; late form of ὑπο-στορέννυμι, to spread or strew under: with accusative of thing(s), Luk.19:36.†; (AS)

G5271.d: ὑπο-κρίνομαι ; [in LXX: (Job.40:2) אּ1 (AB אּ2 ἀπο-, עָנָה), Sir.1:29 35:15 (32:15) Sir.36:2 (33:2), 2Ma.5:25 2Mac 6:21 2Mac 6:24, 4Ma.6:15 4Mac 6:17 * ;] ; __1. = Att.. ἀποκρίνομαι (which see), to answer, reply (Hom., Hdt., al.). ; __2. to answer on the stage, play apart (Arist., al.). Metaphorical, to feign, pretend (Demos., Polyb.): with accusative and inf., Luk.20:20 (cf. Ps sol 4:22).†; (AS)

G5200.d: ὑγρός, -ά, -όν, ; [in LXX: Jdg.16:7,8 (לַח), Job.8:16 (רָשׂב), Sir.39:13 ; wet, moist, opposite to ξηρός: of wood, sappy, green: Luk.23:31.†; (AS)

G5201.d: ὑδρία, -ας, ἠ; (ὕδωρ), [in LXX for בַּד ;] ; __1. prop., a water-pot or jar: Jhn.2:6, 7 John 4:28.; __2. More frequently in Attic = ἄγγυς, a pot, urn or jar of any kind, as for holding wine, coins, etc. (see Rutherford, NPhr., 23; MM, xxv).; † (AS)

G5222.d: ὑπ-άντησις, -εως, ἡ; (ὑπαντάω), [in LXX: Jdg.11:34, εἰς ὑ. (קִרְאָה), etc. ;] ; a going to meet: εἰς ὑ. (see M, Pro.14:1-35 n), Mat.8:34 25:1, Jhn.12:13.†; (AS)
